dialogues.speaker: Lastan
dialogues.text: There's this letter that's really tough to deliver. The recipient is a traveling doctor, so we've got to deliver it while he's here at the tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Lastan
dialogues.text: I don't know why, but it's almost as if this letter is cursed. It always seems to miss him by a hair...

dialogues.speaker: Lastan
dialogues.text: I'm new to this whole courier business, and my more experienced colleagues all assured me that "beginner's luck" was a thing, so they persuaded me to give it a go. We even made a bet...

dialogues.speaker: Lastan
dialogues.text: ...Do you think they were just messing with me?
